label: Price Changes (KPI Change Price)
purpose: Price changes detected between the availability price and later booking-flow steps (cancellation policy / booking rules, booking, modify), with the number of requests checked and the size of the difference. Used to track price stability by supplier, customer and hotel.
grain: One detected price change per request, product and room allocation, by request date and hour.
use_for: number of price changes and price change rate
price change rate by supplier, supplier credential, customer, market or channel
changes by booking-flow step, allowed vs not allowed, availability errors
changes by hour, check-in date or lead-time band
not_for: bookings, sales or profit (Sales Per Owned Hotels, Bookings)
hotel options locked after a price change (History Hotel Locks)
rate updates pushed by hotels' channel managers (Statistics Rate Changes Channel Manager API)

coverage.note: Data starts mid-October 2025; the current month is partial. Monthly volumes grew about sixfold between January and September 2026. [Client Requests] only from 2026-09.

dates.label: Request date
dates.meaning: Day the booking-flow request was made and the price change detected (the cube's main date).

dates.label: Check-in date
dates.meaning: Check-in date of the requested stay; about 2% of changes have no travel date.

measures.name: [Changes]
measures.label: Price changes
measures.definition: Number of price changes detected between the availability price and a later booking-flow step (cancellation policy / booking rules, booking, modify).
measures.notes: Not the same as price-change locks (History Hotel Locks) or channel-manager rate changes.

measures.name: [Requests]
measures.label: Price-check requests
measures.definition: Number of booking-flow requests checked for a price change (the base of the price change rate).
measures.notes: Splits by supplier module, credential, customer, market, channel, interface, hour, travel date and travel window; it does not split by 'Change Allowed' (repeats the total) and is blank for the modify step.

measures.name: [% Changes]
measures.label: Price change rate
measures.notes: Ratio: never add across rows. Do not split by 'Change Allowed' (its denominator does not split).

measures.name: [Client Requests]
measures.label: Client requests
measures.definition: Number of client requests behind the price checks.
measures.notes: Only recorded from 2026-09 (zero before); do not use for earlier periods.

measures.name: [% Changes Client]
measures.label: Price change rate per client request
measures.hidden_reason: misleading: [Client Requests] is only recorded from 2026-09, so the rate is infinite before and inflated over longer periods

measures.name: [Avg Diff Price]
measures.label: Average price difference
measures.definition: Average difference between the availability price and the later price, in AED.
measures.notes: Distorted by extreme outliers (largest difference about 3.08 billion AED); allowed changes average about 243 AED, not-allowed about 27,500 AED. Give it with a caveat.

measures.name: [Max Diff Price]
measures.label: Largest price difference
measures.definition: Largest price difference among the changes in context, in AED.
measures.notes: Contains absurd outliers (billions of AED) in most months.

measures.name: [Min Diff Price]
measures.label: Smallest price difference
measures.definition: Smallest price difference among the changes in context, in AED.
measures.notes: 0 for almost every selection (only the modify step shows a positive minimum).

breakdowns.label: Supplier
breakdowns.meaning: Supplier connection (module) the price came from; the same supplier list as 'Suppliers'[Supplier] in History Hotel Locks. Use it for price change rate by supplier ([Requests] splits by it).

breakdowns.label: Supplier code
breakdowns.meaning: Short code of the supplier connection.

breakdowns.label: Supplier credential
breakdowns.meaning: Supplier account / credential used for the request (finer than the supplier).

breakdowns.label: Booking-flow step
breakdowns.meaning: Step where the change was detected: cancellation policy / booking rules (almost all), booking, or modify.

breakdowns.label: Change allowed
breakdowns.meaning: Whether the price change was allowed (accepted) under the price-change rules.

breakdowns.label: Availability error
breakdowns.meaning: Whether the availability call returned an error.

breakdowns.label: Channel
breakdowns.meaning: Channel of the request: Xml (API), Web (B2B) or B2C.

breakdowns.label: Interface
breakdowns.meaning: Interface of the request: XML, WEB or CLC.

breakdowns.label: Customer
breakdowns.meaning: Client agency that made the request.

breakdowns.label: Market
breakdowns.meaning: Customer market.
sample_values: GCC - Except UAE and Local Residence

breakdowns.label: Account manager
breakdowns.meaning: Account manager responsible for the customer.

breakdowns.label: Integrator
breakdowns.meaning: Technology integrator the customer connects through.

breakdowns.label: Hotel
breakdowns.meaning: Hotel (internal product) whose price changed.

breakdowns.label: Gap availability to booking rules
breakdowns.meaning: Band of the time gap between the availability call and the booking-rules call (unit not documented).

breakdowns.label: Travel window
breakdowns.meaning: Lead-time band between request and check-in; about 70% of changes are Unknown.

breakdowns.label: Handled by re-pricing tool
breakdowns.meaning: Whether a price-optimisation (re-booking) tool sent the request.

breakdowns.label: Hour of day
breakdowns.meaning: Hour of day (00-23) of the request.

breakdowns.label: Year
breakdowns.meaning: Year of the request.

breakdowns.label: Quarter
breakdowns.meaning: Quarter of the request, e.g. Quarter 3, 2026.

breakdowns.label: Month
breakdowns.meaning: Month of the request, e.g. September 2026.
breakdowns.sort_by: 'Create Date'[Month Name.Fecha ISO DESC Month Name]

breakdowns.label: Week of year
breakdowns.meaning: Week number of the request.
breakdowns.sort_by: 'Create Date'[Week Of Year.Week Of Year DESC]

breakdowns.label: Weekday
breakdowns.meaning: Day of week of the request.

breakdowns.label: Check-in month
breakdowns.meaning: Month of check-in, e.g. October 2026.
breakdowns.sort_by: 'Travel Date Start'[Month Name.Fecha ISO DESC Month Name]

named_filters.name: not allowed price changes
named_filters.meaning: Price changes that were not allowed.

named_filters.name: cancellation-policy step
named_filters.meaning: Changes detected at the cancellation-policy / booking-rules check.

named_filters.name: modify step
named_filters.meaning: Changes detected when modifying a booking.

named_filters.name: availability errors
named_filters.meaning: Requests whose availability call returned an error.

named_filters.name: xml channel
named_filters.meaning: Requests through the XML / API channel.

named_filters.name: web channel
named_filters.meaning: Requests through the B2B web channel.

rules: Price change rate is [% Changes] (changes / requests); never add it across rows and do not break it down by 'Change Allowed'.
For 'by supplier' use 'Product Types'[Module]; 'Credentials'[Credential] is the finer supplier account.
[Avg Diff Price] and [Max Diff Price] are distorted by extreme outliers: give them with a caveat, prefer [Changes] and [% Changes].
Do not split by 'Currency'[Currency Ref]: both values return the same totals; differences are in AED.
Always put a breakdown's needs_columns next to it; 'Channels' and 'Interfaces' columns and the Year column need none.
Use the cube's measures only; never SUM a column.

review.question: Does 'price change rate' mean changes per request ([% Changes], about 4%) or changes per client request ([% Changes Client])?
review.why: [Client Requests] is only recorded from 2026-09, so [% Changes Client] is infinite before and inflated over longer periods; [% Changes] is consistent over the whole history and splits by supplier.
